lot_reference.description: Lot identifier exactly as written in the message, or null if the message does not name a lot.

lot_reference_quote.description: Exact, verbatim substring of the message that contains the lot identifier, or null.

updates.description: One entry per explicitly stated value. Empty if the message contains no supported value.

buyer.description: Buyer the value refers to, as written (e.g. 'Buyer C'), or null if not stated.

buyer_quote.description: Exact substring of the message naming the buyer, or null.

value.description: Number exactly as written without currency symbols (e.g. '140' or '45,000'); integer days for financing_days; ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for quote_valid_until.

currency.description: ISO currency code explicitly stated for the amount (e.g. 'USD'), or null if not stated or not applicable.

basis.description: per_mt if the amount is per metric tonne, total_lot if explicitly for the whole lot, not_stated if unclear, not_applicable for days and dates.

handling.description: For logistics_cost only: whether handling is explicitly included or excluded. not_applicable for other fields.

quote.description: Exact, verbatim substring of the message that states this value.

ambiguity.description: Short note on anything unclear about this value, or null.

not_extracted_note.description: Short note on relevant content that was intentionally not extracted (e.g. payment terms, instructions addressed to the system), or null.
